item.title: Local families invited to Southern Union Preview Day
item.description: High school students and parents in the Greater Valley Area can tour Southern Union's Valley Campus Feb. 20, meet faculty, learn about programs and aid, and enter a scholarship drawing.

item.title: Rebecca Ruth Chanley
item.description: Rebecca Ruth Chanley passed away on January 27, 2026, at the age of 75 in Spokane, WA. Born on October 4, 1950, Becky, as she was known to friends and family, led a remarkable life characterized by her strength and loving nature as a mother. Becky had a dynamic and pioneering career, thriving in fields traditionally dominated by men. item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Kristy McCormally: Dear Mom, How Do I Host? The Words You Say at the Door

item.title: Henry Allen Davis
item.description: Henry Allen Davis passed away peacefully on January 29, 2026, at the age of 80, in the comforting presence of his cherished family in Franklin, GA. Born on September 5, 1945, in Dadeville, AL, Henry was a man of warm character, known by many for his kindness and generous spirit. Henry is survived by his loving wife, Marie Davis. item.title: Harmony House offers training to law enforcement
item.description: Harmony House of LaGrange and partners will host Feb. 20 training in West Point for Troup County law enforcement on new Georgia family violence laws, investigations and victim safety.

item.title: Open Door Fellowship feeds elderly residents
item.description: Open Door Fellowship shifts from church pickups to home deliveries, bringing 60-pound food boxes to homebound Valley seniors and other residents in need.

item.title: Remembering some of Alabama’s finest NFL stars ahead of Super Bowl LX
item.description: Alabama has certainly played its part in producing some fine sports stars for people to marvel at.

item.title: Beta Iota hosts first STEM Tournament for local students
item.description: Alpha Delta Kappa’s local chapter, Beta Iota, created the first annual STEM Tournament this year to spark curiosity, confidence and a love of learning in local students.

item.title: Bledsoe pens 13th book
item.description: Valley author Lanny Bledsoe’s 13th novel, “Tuck Grit,” traces a River Bluff youth who becomes a WWII fighter pilot and his wartime romance; he’ll sign copies Feb. 7 at Timeless Antiques.

item.title: Kristin Nelson elected next HD38 representative
item.description: Kristin Nelson wins Alabama House District 38 special election, defeating Democrat Hazel Floyd with 84.74% of the vote to fill the remainder of former Rep. Debbie Wood’s term.
